description: Produce a referential integrity report for the logistics tracker's shipments table. Report three checks, each as one row: 'orphan_warehouse' = shipments whose warehouse_id is not NULL and has no match in warehouses; 'orphan_carrier' = shipments whose carrier_id is not NULL and has no match in carriers; 'null_carrier' = shipments whose carrier_id is NULL. Every check must appear even when its violation count is 0. Output columns: check_name (STRING), violation_count (INT64), min_shipment_id (INT64, smallest violating shipment_id or NULL). Sort by check_name.

carrier_id.description: Foreign key to carriers; NULL until a carrier is assigned

edge_cases: NULL carrier_id is a NULL violation, not an orphan
A shipment can violate several checks at once (shipment 4)
Checks with zero violations must still be returned with violation_count = 0
Duplicate keys in the parent tables must not inflate violation counts
common_failure_modes: FM5: NOT IN against a parent column containing NULL returns no orphans; LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL also counts NULL foreign keys as orphans unless filtered
FM7: Aggregating only violating rows returns no row for a passing check, making 'passed' indistinguishable from 'not run'
